scenarios.reasoning: The agent demonstrated good technical skills — installing tools, writing a custom C# parser, extracting structured data from the binlog. However, it got the core analytical question wrong: it incorrectly concluded LrgWindowsAppManifest was built as part of the solution when it was not. This fundamental error cascaded into missing the configuration mismatch and the root cause explanation. The agent also didn't fully present the project list. While the process was methodical, the conclusions were incorrect on the most important points.
scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path
